claims.claim: In Phase 3 trials, the 12-month vaccine efficacy was 75% in locations characterized by seasonal variations and 68% in standard locations.

citations.quote: Notably, phase 3 clinical trials have shown the R21/Matrix-M 12-month Vaccine Efficacy (VE) to be 75% in locations characterized by seasonal variations, while it registered at 68% in standard locations [1].

claims.quote: Notably, phase 3 clinical trials have shown the R21/Matrix-M 12-month Vaccine Efficacy (VE) to be 75% in locations characterized by seasonal variations, while it registered at 68% in standard locations [1].

claims.claim: Against multiple clinical malaria episodes, the efficacy was 75% at the seasonal sites and 67% at the standard sites.

citations.quote: Specifically, over 12 months, VE for the time leading up to the initial clinical malaria episode was 75% in the seasonal sites and 68% in the standard sites [1]. Similarly, VE against multiple clinical malaria episodes exhibited comparable figures: 75% in the seasonal sites and 67% in the standard sites.
